Name: Bridge Suits
Author: monxas
Description: Inserts the four bridge suit symbols (♠ ♥ ♦ ♣), or any text you capture from the clipboard, as coloured, editable rich text into Microsoft Word and other rich-text editors on Windows and macOS.

Actions.Name: Insert Bridge Suit
Actions.Tooltip: Pastes a coloured ♠ ♥ ♦ ♣ into the focused document.

Actions.Name: Insert Captured Text
Actions.Tooltip: Pastes text you captured from the clipboard (a symbol, 1NT, ♠AKQ...) with its colour and, optionally, its font, size and style.
